Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: System Event Code

Field.Name: Current Year
Field.Description: The current calendar year (example: 2016).

Field.Name: Current Month
Field.Description: The current calendar month, with values 1 to 12 inclusive, January=1, etc.

Field.Name: Current Day
Field.Description: The current calendar day, with values 1 to 31 inclusive.

Field.Name: Version
Field.Description: Version of this interface. Currently set to 1.

Field.Name: Sub-version
Field.Description: Sub-version of this interface. Currently set to 0.

Message.Name: Option Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, the options system disseminates directory messages for all symbols eligible for trading in the options system.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID for this option, assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the option root symbol (security symbol)

Field.Name: Expiration Year
Field.Description: Last two digits of the year of the option expiration

Field.Name: Expiration Month
Field.Description: Expiration Month of the option (1-12)

Field.Name: Expiration Day
Field.Description: Day of the Month of expiration (1-31)

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price in fixed point format with 12 whole number places followed by 8 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: Option Type value

Field.Name: Source
Field.Description: Identifies the source of the option, valid for the trading day.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the unique symbol assigned to the underlying security within the Exchange System.

Field.Name: Trading Type
Field.Description: Indicates what kind of option this is

Field.Name: Contract Size
Field.Description: Underlying deliverable size

Field.Name: Option Closing Type
Field.Description: Denotes which System Event is used to determine when trading ceases in this symbol.

Field.Name: Tradable
Field.Description: Denotes whether or not this option is tradable at the exchange

Field.Name: MPV
Field.Description: Minimum Price Variation for this option

Field.Name: Closing Only
Field.Description: Closing position of the option

Message.Name: Trading Action Message
Message.Description: The options system uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of an index or equity option within the options market.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the options security in the options market.

Message.Name: Security Open/Closed Message
Message.Description: The options system uses this administrative message to indicate when an option has completed the opening process and is now available for auto execution or when the option has closed and is no longer available for auto execution.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Open State
Field.Description: Reflects the current eligibility for auto execution of the options security in the options market.

Message.Name: Opening Imbalance Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq disseminates Opening Imbalance information at regular intervals in the time leading up to the Nasdaq Opening Auction events.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Paired Contracts
Field.Description: The total number of contracts that are eligible to be matched at the Current Reference Price.

Field.Name: Imbalance Direction
Field.Description: Indicates the market side of the imbalance

Field.Name: Imbalance Price
Field.Description: The imbalance price in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Imbalance Volume
Field.Description: The imbalance volume.

Message.Name: Order on Book Message
Message.Description: An Order on Book message is generated for all the following situations whenever an order free from any display restrictions is reported by the matching engine.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Order Type
Field.Description: ‘M’ = Market ‘L’ = Limit

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side value

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of the order in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits. For market orders, the price is zero. Hidden prices are set to zero.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Size of the order (zero if hidden)

Field.Name: Exec Flag
Field.Description: Exec Flag value

Field.Name: Order Capacity
Field.Description: Order capacity value

Field.Name: Owner ID
Field.Description: Spaces when not set

Field.Name: Giveup
Field.Description: Spaces when not set

Field.Name: CMTA
Field.Description: Spaces when not set

Message.Name: Auction Message
Message.Description: This message is used to announce auctions. The start of auction is announced, followed by possible updates on the auction, and announcing the end of the auction.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Integer which uniquely identifies the auction.

Field.Name: Order Type
Field.Description: ‘M’ = Market ‘L’ = Limit

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side value

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits. For market orders, the price is zero. Hidden prices are set to zero

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Size (zero if hidden)

Field.Name: Exec Flag
Field.Description: ‘N’ = None ‘A’ = AON

Field.Name: Order Capacity
Field.Description: Order capacity value

Field.Name: Owner ID
Field.Description: Spaces when not set

Field.Name: Giveup
Field.Description: Spaces when not set

Field.Name: CMTA
Field.Description: Spaces when not set

Field.Name: Auction Event
Field.Description: ‘S’ = Start ‘U’ = Auction Update ‘E’ = End of Auction

Field.Name: Number Of Responses
Field.Description: Number of auction Responses. Next two fields repeat that number of times. Allowable values for this field are 0 or 1.

Field.Name: Response Price
Field.Description: Best price of the auction response in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits. The response, if shown (zero if not shown) is the best response on the contra side.

Field.Name: Response Size
Field.Description: Best size of the auction response (zero if not shown).

Value.Name: Start of Normal Hours Closing Process
Value.Description: Start of Normal Hours Closing Process

Value.Name: Start of Late Hours Closing Process
Value.Description: Start of Late Hours Closing Process
